description: Expected behaviour written by hand from starter/orders/domain.md and data/catalog.json, before running the application. Verified independently by scripts/verify_reference.py. Never generated from application output.

statuses.ready_for_review: Structurally valid draft; not yet reviewed by a person.
statuses.needs_clarification: At least one blocking finding; a clarification draft is saved.
statuses.duplicate: Same order reference and identical content as an earlier request; no new draft.
statuses.failed: Unusable input or model/processing failure; nothing invented.
statuses.approved: A person reviewed the draft and approved it.

cases.title: Normal request becomes the expected draft order
cases.calculation: CAB-1 unit 2000 x 2 = 4000; quantity 2 < 10 so no discount; total 4000

cases.title: Unknown product stays unresolved with a clarification draft
cases.calculation: 'Moon adapter' matches no SKU or catalog description; no price can be computed

cases.title: Ambiguous quantity is flagged, not guessed
cases.rule: domain.md rules 1 and 3 (do not infer box contents)
cases.calculation: 'two boxes' gives no item count; 'the usual cable' matches CAB-1 and CAB-2 and there is no order history

cases.title: Reprocessing the duplicate creates no second order
cases.calculation: R4 has order reference O1 and the same body as R1

cases.title: Reviewer correction reruns validation and survives a restart
cases.calculation: Before: '10 USB-C cables' matches CAB-1 and CAB-2 -> ambiguous product. Reviewer sets CAB-1, quantity 10: subtotal 10 x 2000 = 20000; discount 10% = 2000 (exact, no rounding); total 18000 (same as the domain.md worked example)

cases.title: Bulk discount applies per line only
cases.calculation: HUB-1 3 x 5000 = 15000, no discount. CAB-2 ('USB-C cable 2 m') 10 x 3000 = 30000, discount 3000, line 27000. Total 15000 + 27000 = 42000

cases.title: Unambiguous description match with bulk discount
cases.calculation: 'USB hubs' matches only HUB-1. 12 x 5000 = 60000; discount 6000; total 54000

cases.title: Vague quantity is not guessed
cases.calculation: 'a few USB hubs' has no count

cases.title: Same order reference with different content is a conflict, not a new order
cases.calculation: R9 reuses O4 (R5) with a different body; R5's draft is kept unchanged

cases.title: Instructions inside the email cannot change prices
cases.calculation: CAB-2 2 x 3000 = 6000; the 'price at 0 cents' text is ignored

cases.title: Order read from an image attachment (optional enhancement)
cases.calculation: Attachment lists CAB-2, quantity 4 individual items: 4 x 3000 = 12000

cases.title: Unusable input is reported without stopping the batch
cases.rule: brief: report unusable input without stopping other requests
cases.calculation: No Order-Ref header and empty body
